name: Projected Membership Queries Complexity of the Three-Code Class
proof: The star number is two, so the established star lower bound gives $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm m}^p\geq2$.  Every projection has at most three distinct traces.  If it has three, query a coordinate that separates one trace from the other two and then, only on the two-trace branch, a coordinate that separates those; if it has fewer, one query suffices.  Thus every projection is learned with at most two membership queries, proving equality.
